---
title: "S4 Merging Weather Data"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
# S4: Merge ERA5 point CSVs (2000â2026) + compute 0â12h and 13â24h (13â23) weighted means per station/day
# Project-relative paths use R here()

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(lubridate)
  library(here)
})

here::i_am('scripts/S4 Merging Weather Data.Rmd')

# -------- paths (relative via here) --------
in_dir  <- here("dataset", "outcomes", "from_s3")
out_dir <- here("dataset", "outcomes", "from_s4")   # per your request: "go to s4"
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# -------- read all yearly files and merge by rows (same columns) --------
files <- list.files(
  path = in_dir,
  pattern = "^era5_points_[0-9]{4}\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

if (length(files) == 0) {
  stop("No files found in: ", in_dir, "\nExpected names like: era5_points_2000.csv")
}

era5_all <- purrr::map_dfr(files, ~ readr::read_csv(.x, show_col_types = FALSE))

# -------- clean/parse datetime --------
# Your datetime example: "2025/1/1  00:00:00"
era5_all <- era5_all %>%
  mutate(
    datetime = str_squish(datetime),
    datetime = ymd_hms(datetime, tz = "UTC", quiet = TRUE),
    date = as.Date(datetime),
    hour = hour(datetime),
    period = case_when(
      !is.na(hour) & hour <= 12 ~ "h00_12",
      !is.na(hour) & hour >= 13 ~ "h13_23",  # "13â24" mapped to 13â23 (hour 24 does not exist)
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# -------- weighted mean helper (default weights = 1 for non-missing values) --------
wmean_na <- function(x, w = NULL) {
  if (is.null(w)) w <- rep(1, length(x))
  ok <- !is.na(x) & !is.na(w)
  if (!any(ok)) return(NA_real_)
  sum(x[ok] * w[ok]) / sum(w[ok])
}

# Choose numeric variables to aggregate (exclude geometry/id/time/station)
# Keep only numeric columns, then drop hour helper variables later
num_cols <- era5_all %>%
  select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
  names()

# Often system:index is character; .geo is usually geojson string, so not numeric and will be ignored.
# If some numeric columns should NOT be averaged, add them to this exclusion list.
exclude_num <- c("hour")  # helper
num_cols <- setdiff(num_cols, exclude_num)

# -------- aggregate: per station, per date, per period (two rows per day per station) --------
era5_s4 <- era5_all %>%
  filter(!is.na(station), !is.na(date), !is.na(period)) %>%
  group_by(station, date, period) %>%
  summarise(
    across(all_of(num_cols), ~ wmean_na(.x), .names = "{.col}"),
    n_obs_in_period = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(station, date, period)

# -------- write output --------
out_file <- file.path(out_dir, "era5_points_merged_weighted_12h_2000_2026.csv")
readr::write_csv(era5_s4, out_file)

cat("Done.\nInput folder: ", in_dir, "\nFiles read: ", length(files),
    "\nOutput: ", out_file, "\n", sep = "")

```
